sources.snippet: What This Is PHI-CTRL is a closed-loop fault-tolerant flight control framework that extends the PHI-Twin digital twin from monitoring to acting. When a fault is detected in-flight, the system autonomously reconfigures its control strategy without human intervention — what engineers call autonomous control reconfiguration.
